# ToggleButton

Header: `winui/ui/input/ToggleButton.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/ToggleButton.hpp`.

A [Button](button.md#uibutton) that stays pressed, with a nullable checked state.

Everything a [Button](button.md#uibutton) has (text or content, style, padding, focus, Enter/Space, [`on_click()`](button.md#on_click)) still applies. Each activation first advances the state (unchecked -> checked -> unchecked, or -> indeterminate when [three_state()](#three_state) is on) and then runs the click handler.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> bold{false};

auto toolbar = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Horizontal);
auto* toggle = toolbar->add(std::make_unique<ui::ToggleButtonControl>("Bold"));
toggle->on_checked_changed([&](std::optional<bool> on) { bold = on; });

// Or declaratively, bound both ways through the Property:
toolbar->add(ui::ToggleButton{
    .text               = "Italic",
    .checked            = bold,
}.build());
window.set_content(std::move(toolbar));
```

## `ui::ToggleButton`

A button that stays pressed. Builds a [ui::ToggleButtonControl](#uitogglebuttoncontrol). [`checked`](#uitogglebutton-checked) is nullable, as [ui::CheckBox](check-box.md#uicheckbox)'s is, and two-way with [ui::bind()](../core/namespace-ui.md#bind) of a [`Property<std::optional<bool>>`](../core/property.md). [`three_state`](#uitogglebutton-three_state) lets a click reach indeterminate.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> bold{false};

window.set_content(ui::ToggleButton{.text = "Bold", .checked = bold});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::ToggleButton{
    .text, .checked, .three_state, .padding, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width,
    .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible,
    .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .command, .command_parameter, .on_click,
    .on_checked_changed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus,
    .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-text"></span>`text` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The label, ignored while [`.content`](#uitogglebutton-content) is set. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-checked"></span>`checked` | `ui::CheckedField` | `{false}` | True, false, or std::nullopt for indeterminate. Seeding it raises nothing. Two-way with a [`Property<bool>`](../core/property.md) (a click writes true or false; an indeterminate state set on the control writes nothing) or a [`Property<std::optional<bool>>`](../core/property.md) (every state). See [ui::CheckedField](../core/checked-field.md). |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-three_state"></span>`three_state` | `bool` | `false` | A click also reaches indeterminate: unchecked, checked, indeterminate, unchecked. Without it, a click on an indeterminate button checks it. Needs [`checked`](#uitogglebutton-checked) bound to a [`Property<std::optional<bool>>`](../core/property.md) (or one-way), since a [`Property<bool>`](../core/property.md) cannot hold the third state; a debug build asserts on that. Read once, when the spec is built. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-padding"></span>`padding` | `ui::Binding<std::optional<ui::Thickness>>` |  | The padding around the text or content; nullopt keeps the theme's button padding. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-command"></span>`command` | `ui::CommandRef` |  | A shared, named action (ui/Command.hpp), as [ui::Button](button.md#uibutton)'s: run after [`.on_click`](#uitogglebutton-on_click) with [`.command_parameter`](#uitogglebutton-command_parameter), and the button is enabled only while both the command and [`.enabled`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) allow it. An unset [`.tool_tip`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) falls back to the command's description. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-command_parameter"></span>`command_parameter` | `std::string` |  | Handed to [`.command`](#uitogglebutton-command) when it runs. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-on_click"></span>`on_click` | `ui::Action` |  | Click, as [ui::Button](button.md#uibutton)'s. The checked state has already changed when it runs. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-on_checked_changed"></span>`on_checked_changed` | `ui::Callback<void(std::optional<bool>)>` |  | The new state after the user changed it, including into and out of indeterminate. A bound value doesn't run it. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uitogglebutton-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |

## `ui::ToggleButtonControl`

Derives from `ui::ButtonControl`, `ui::ToggleProvider`.

A [Button](button.md#uibutton) that stays pressed, with a nullable checked state.

Everything a [Button](button.md#uibutton) has (text or content, style, padding, focus, Enter/Space, [`on_click()`](button.md#on_click)) still applies. Each activation first advances the state (unchecked -> checked -> unchecked, or -> indeterminate when [three_state()](#three_state) is on) and then runs the click handler.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<bool>> bold{false};

auto toolbar = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Horizontal);
auto* toggle = toolbar->add(std::make_unique<ui::ToggleButtonControl>("Bold"));
toggle->on_checked_changed([&](std::optional<bool> on) { bold = on; });

// Or declaratively, bound both ways through the Property:
toolbar->add(ui::ToggleButton{
    .text               = "Italic",
    .checked            = bold,
}.build());
window.set_content(std::move(toolbar));
```

### ToggleButtonControl

```cpp
ToggleButtonControl() = default
```

An unchecked toggle with no text; give it text with [set_text()](button.md#set_text) or content with [set_content()](button.md#set_content).

### ToggleButtonControl

```cpp
ToggleButtonControl(std::string text, std::optional<bool> checked = false)
```

A toggle labeled [`text`](button.md#text), starting in [`checked`](#checked) (`std::nullopt` is indeterminate).

### checked

```cpp
std::optional<bool> checked() const
```

The checked state: `true`, `false`, or `std::nullopt` for indeterminate. Defaults to `false`.

### set_checked

```cpp
void set_checked(std::optional<bool> checked)
```

Changes the state and redraws. A no-op when unchanged; otherwise fires [on_checked_changed()](#on_checked_changed). Any value may be set, even `std::nullopt` without [three_state()](#three_state).

### three_state

```cpp
bool three_state() const
```

Whether a click can reach indeterminate (checked -> indeterminate -> unchecked). Off by default.

### set_three_state

```cpp
void set_three_state(bool three_state)
```

Takes effect on the next activation; does not change the current state.

### on_checked_changed

```cpp
void on_checked_changed(Callback<void(std::optional<bool>)> handler)
```

Invoked with the new state whenever [`checked`](#checked) changes (click, Enter/Space, UI Automation or [set_checked()](#set_checked)), including into and out of indeterminate. Replaces any previous handler.

### on_activated

```cpp
void on_activated() override
```

Advances the checked state before the click handler runs.

### current_visual

```cpp
ButtonVisual current_visual(const Theme& theme) const override
```

The accent button's colors while checked; the standard button's otherwise.
